title: Groups and arrays
summary: Find totals to 30, share equally, and tell grouping from sharing.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 counts 4 groups of 5 (20). Child skip-counts in fives. Q2 counts 3 groups of 10 (30). Q3 makes 2 groups of 5. Q4 finds how many groups of 5 from 20. Q5 shares 20 equally between 4. Q6 matches 30 to 3 groups of 10. Q7 spots equal groups. Q8 finds the size of 3 equal groups that make 15. Q9 taps two equal-group pictures. Q10 orders group totals from fewest to most.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses small equal groups of 2 and 5, totals to 10, sharing into 2, and grouping 10 into twos. Medium uses totals to 30, groups of 10, and grouping versus sharing stories. Hard reads an array both ways, finds a missing number of groups, and spots unequal groups. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
